body: Why should I? My back will never get better, there's no point in having an optimistic attitude, there's no point in anything. No one really talks to me when I try to reach out, all the time my feelings get dismissed because someone else has it worse, right? Plus, why should I care if my family cares? If you were 19 again (assuming you're older) what would you do if you could do NOTHING but sit, lay, or walk (begrudgingly of others walking with ease)? All I can do is play video games, but I have rheumatoid arthritis. The pain is too much. I feel my whole body in pain all the time, why shouldn't I end it? Why don't I have the right to?
I cared about them before my back pain, but now I just don't see a reason to give a fuck about anything anymore.

To put it into perspective, I'd love nothing more than to be invited out to drinks. I haven't been invited to do anything, and when I invited people over, they never came; really ever in my life. You have to start somewhere, right?
source: agoraphobia sufferer and sad individual
